test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following company was announced as the official kit sponsor of Team India by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mobile Premier League.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **MPL Sports designed and manufactured jerseys will be worn by Men's, Women’s, and the Under-19 Indian cricket teams.**
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced its partnership with MPL Sports.
 
• Mobile Premier League, **India’s largest esports platform**, is the new kit sponsor and official merchandise partner for the Indian Cricket Team.
 
• Under the newly-inked strategic partnership, MPL Sports entered into** a three-year agreement** from **November 2020 to December 2023.**
 
• MPL Sports’ association with the BCCI begins with the upcoming** India tour of Australia, 2020-21,** which will see Team India sporting the new jerseys.
 
• The senior men and women and the Under-19 teams are also a part of the deal for the new kits.
 
• Apart from Team India jerseys,** MPL Sports will also sell licensed Team India merchandise.**
